items.desc: Trump just lost Congress. History has already run this experiment five times, and every president faced the same three choices: fight it, deal with it, or sink with it. cm.t: People in the comments are 100%, correct. In the scene, Queen Sibylla (Eva Green) is sealing a letter with hot wax alongside her young son, Baldwin V, when a drop of hot wax lands directly on his hand. The premise of the scene is Sibylla's devastating realization that her son has leprosy—just like his late uncle, King Baldwin IV—because he lacks nerve sensitivity and feels no pain from the burn.
cm.ko: 댓글에 언급된 내용은 100% 정확합니다. 장면에서, 퀸 시빌라(에바 그린)는 어린 아들 발던 V와 함께 뜨거운 왁스로 편지를 봉하며, 이때 왁스가 발던 V의 손에 직접 떨어집니다. 이 장면의 배경은 시빌라가 자신의 아들이 레버를 앓고 있다는 것을 깨닫는 상황입니다—바로 헨
